This name gives a sense of pride and honor to the bearer, emphasizing the importance of beauty and grace in Islamic traditions.

In Islamic tradition, the outer adornments or 'jawar' serve as a reminder of the inner adornments of a person, such as virtues, manners, and good character. This name inspires the bearer to strive for inner beauty and to adorn herself with good deeds and virtues. Through this name, the bearer is reminded of her worth as a precious creation of Allah, and is encouraged to reflect His image in her actions and character.
